capabilities.title: Logical profile export
capabilities.notes: SEC-02: Implemented in M1 Wave 1 — the legacy export is now a logical allowlist archive (format v2: manifest.json with exported tables/counts, exclusions and redactions, one JSONL per allowlisted table, no DB snapshot; apps/server/src/lib/profileExport.ts). Sentinel tests prove provider/plugin secrets and OAuth material stay out of the archive; kernel export.profile lands in M3.

capabilities.title: Plugin network broker (SSRF policy + bounded streaming)
capabilities.notes: SEC-03/SEC-04 (M1 Wave 1 + Wave 2): plugin network.http.fetch and socket destinations pass the §29.1 SSRF scope policy — every DNS answer checked, bracketed IPv6 and IPv4-mapped literals normalized, per-hop redirect re-checks, connect to the policy-approved IP with the hostname only in Host/SNI and post-connect remoteAddress verification; response bodies are capped while streaming and the connection is destroyed on exceed (apps/plugin-runtime/src/host). Wave 2 (SEC-04): global and per-plugin in-flight byte budgets (NETWORK_MAX_INFLIGHT_BYTES_GLOBAL=64 MiB, NETWORK_MAX_INFLIGHT_BYTES_PER_PLUGIN=16 MiB, worst-case reservation per fetch body NETWORK_MAX_BODY_BYTES) fail a NEW request with the stable NETWORK_INFLIGHT_LIMIT before its body is read, and release on success/error/cancel; two host tests cover both budgets (including a cross-plugin global trip with 8 concurrent held fetches). WebSocket post-connect verification is a documented follow-up.

capabilities.title: Plugin package trust (signature/digest verification)
capabilities.notes: SEC-05 (M1 Wave 1): publisher Ed25519 signature + per-file sha256 digest verification before consent/install (format neotavern.package-signature.v1, apps/server/src/lib/packageTrust.ts); trust states built-in / verified-publisher / locally-trusted / unsigned-untrusted recorded in the plugin registry (migration 0023) and surfaced as InstalledPlugin.trust; NEOTA_PLUGIN_PUBLISHER_KEYS keyring + NEOTA_PLUGIN_REQUIRE_SIGNATURE policy; unsigned packages enabled via consent become locally-trusted; ZIP/tar.gz reject duplicate normalized paths, symlinks, traversal, encrypted entries and bounded zip bombs.

capabilities.title: Restore maintenance lock (global maintenance mode)
capabilities.notes: M1 Wave 1 (ТЗ §10.4): restore runs exclusively under a global maintenance lock (apps/server/src/lib/maintenance.ts) — while held, new product mutations are rejected with the stable MAINTENANCE_MODE error (503), plugin activation is blocked and no second restore can enter; read-only requests and backup/diagnostics tooling keep working; the lock is released on every exit path (success and failure). Full stop-the-world (suspending in-flight generations, staged data-root activation) is the M3 DATA-ACTIVATE slice.

capabilities.title: SecretStore (secrets out of the main DB, portable secrets.enc)
capabilities.notes: SEC-01 (M1 Wave 1): new SecretStore port package (packages/secret-store) with three explicit backends — portable encrypted secrets.enc (AES-256-GCM, versioned scrypt KDF, authenticated header, atomic writes, fresh nonce per write, machine-independent key derivation, lock/re-encrypt), session-only memory (no plaintext fallback) and a read-only env provider for headless (NEOTA_SECRET_*). Provider and plugin secrets no longer live in app.db: migration 0024 adds value_ref columns and the DB stores only opaque references (portable:/session:/env:), resolved at runtime via ctx.secrets (apps/server/src/lib/secretStore.ts, migration 0024). Pre-migration plaintext rows are imported at bootstrap (idempotent). A reference whose backend cannot produce the value surfaces SECRET_UNAVAILABLE_ON_THIS_DEVICE (422) — never a plaintext fallback; backups and profile exports contain no secrets. Kernel-plane port delivered (crates/secret-store, ADR-0040): canonical portable v2 format with Argon2id (m=64 MiB/t=3/p=1) + AES-256-GCM, authenticated header, staged re-encryption, cross-machine portability tests (15 tests). OS-vault / Android Keystore adapters and the full portable UX (passphrase prompt, auto-lock UI) remain M3.

capabilities.title: Legacy compatibility authority boundary (ARC-11)
capabilities.notes: M1 Wave 1 (ТЗ §14.2, ADR-0039): per-legacy-API authority map shipped as packages/legacy-compat/COMPATIBILITY.md and enforced by apps/server/test/legacyAuthority.spec.ts — legacy Express routers are confined to /api/plugins/{id}/... (core /api/v2 routes are never shadowed), extension settings are namespaced per installed plugin with a 1 MiB bound, and the scoped plugin VFS is wired to <data-root>/plugins/{id}/data with ../ and backslash escapes rejected and files.plugin required (PLUGIN_PERMISSION_DENIED without the grant).
